name: Eating Animal Blood
overview: Scripture clearly instructs God's people to abstain from consuming animal blood, emphasizing that the life of the flesh is in the blood, which God has set apart for atonement on the altar. While God initially permitted the eating of all living creatures after the flood, He explicitly prohibited eating blood as a perpetual statute, warning that those who disregard this command will face serious consequences. This restriction highlights the sacredness of blood as the means of atonement and points believers to the seriousness of life and redemption in Christ.
